q: What is Figure A that is a decorative concrete pavement finished using a patterned template to create surface designs resembling bricks, tiles, or stones?
n: Stenciled concrete uses a pattern template.

q: What is Figure B that is a decorative concrete pavement finished by impressing patterns into fresh concrete to give the look of natural materials?
n: Stamped concrete is pressed with patterns while fresh.

q: What is Figure C that is a concrete surface with a textured finish created by dragging a tool over it for added slip resistance?
n: A broom finish is dragged across for slip resistance.

q: What is Figure D that is a concrete finish where the top layer is washed off to expose decorative aggregates for a textured look?
n: The surface paste is washed off to expose the aggregate.

q: What is Figure E that is a decorative flooring material made from chips of stone or marble set in concrete and polished to a smooth surface?
n: Terrazzo is marble chips in a polished matrix.

q: What material, shown in Item B, is typically used to fill the joints between mosaic tiles for sealing and stability?
n: Grout fills the joints between tiles.

q: What type of paving material is Item C, which is fully manufactured and widely used for its durability in paving applications?
n: Concrete pavers are factory-made and durable.

q: Which type of paving material, shown in Item D, is most suitable for outdoor playgrounds due to its soft, shock- absorbing properties?
n: Rubber pavers absorb impact, suiting playgrounds.

q: What type of paving material, shown in Item E, is known for being environmentally friendly and often used in sustainable design projects?
n: Natural stone needs little processing, a low-impact choice.

q: What is Figure B, a type of white coral stone commonly used in residential walls?
n: Mactan stone is the white coral stone of Cebu.

q: Which company is a leading maker of architectural and structural wood products in the Philippines?
n: Matimco makes treated lumber and engineered wood.

q: Which brand of thermosetting plastic laminate is used as a heat- and chemical-resistant surface on furniture and wall panels?
n: Formica is the classic high-pressure laminate.

q: Which of these is a gypsum board brand?
n: HardieFlex is fiber cement; Mapei is adhesives.

q: What board covers the bottom of an interior wall to hide the wall–floor joint?
n: Baseboards also protect the wall from knocks.

q: What board is placed above curtains to hide the rod and hardware?
n: A cornice board boxes in the curtain head.

q: What resilient strip on a wall protects it from carts and movable equipment?
n: Wall guards (crash rails) are common in hospitals.

q: What piece goes between a door and the floor finish?
n: The threshold covers the floor joint at the door.

q: What is paneling on the lower part of a wall only called?
n: Wainscot covers the lower wall.

q: Which is NOT part of a suspended ceiling framing system?
n: The others make up the ceiling frame.

q: What tape is used on gypsum board joints before applying joint compound?
n: Paper or mesh joint tape is bedded in joint compound to bridge board seams.

q: What ceiling hides ductwork while still allowing maintenance access?
n: Lift-out panels give access to the plenum.

q: What supports and aligns the panels in a suspended ceiling?
n: Main tees and cross tees form the grid.

q: What keeps the joints between gypsum boards from cracking?
n: Tape embedded in compound bridges the joint.

q: What is the best lighting to highlight a painting?
n: A focused beam accents the artwork.

q: What lighting is best for a workspace or reading area?
n: Task lighting targets the work surface.

q: Which wall-mounted fixture gives both decorative and functional light?
n: Sconces mount on walls.

q: Which lighting emphasizes architectural features, art or displays?
n: Accent lighting creates contrast on a focal point.

q: Which lighting creates a warm, inviting feel in a living room?
n: Soft general light sets the mood.

q: What general term covers particle board, fiberboard and gypsum board?
n: All are sheet wallboards.

q: Fiber cement board is mainly cement, cellulose fiber and ______.
n: Ground silica sand is the filler.

q: Which ceiling material is chosen because it absorbs sound?
n: Acoustic (mineral fiber) board is porous and absorbs sound.

q: What is the standard size of a marine plywood sheet?
n: 4 ft × 8 ft.

q: What is the standard thickness of gypsum board for wall partitions?
n: 12 mm (1/2") is standard for walls.

q: What is placed between two surfaces to stop gas, oil or other substances passing through?
n: A sealant (or gasket) closes the joint.

q: Which material has the lowest embodied carbon per kilogram before delivery to site?
n: Primary aluminum and copper are far more energy-intensive.

q: Which paver best reduces outdoor heat gain and helps keep interiors cool?
n: Light colors reflect sunlight.
